del_all.menu: Delete all past sessions not done
del_all.title: Delete all past sessions that weren't done
del_all.body: {n} sessions on past days weren't done (missed, or past and not matched to an activity yet). Once deleted they no longer show in the plan or the compliance page, and the automatic adjustment won't add them back; those still on the watch's calendar are removed too. Completed sessions are not affected.

rest.chip_title:
Rest day: no automatic session on this day; the week's volume goes to the other days
Click or right-click (long-press) to cancel
rest.day_tip:
{wd} {day} — rest day
Right-click (long-press on a phone) to cancel
rest.undo_body: Plan {wd} {day} as usual again? Upcoming sessions you haven't edited are re-planned from the current state.
rest.legend_tip: Right-click an empty day (long-press on a phone) → "Make it a rest day": no automatic session that day. Unlike blocked dates, the week's training volume is not reduced — it goes to the other days of the week (long run first, hard days apart, the usual placement rules). The same menu cancels it.
